Hidden by the Finding 12 timeout defect, not by any evidence. The register returns 1160558 as BREAST CANCER NOW, Registered, income GBP 59,270,000; breastcancernow.org states 'charity registered in England and Wales (1160558)'; Companies House names company 09347608 BREAST CANCER NOW.

The register holds no charity 264818 at all - not as registered and not as removed - which settles open item 10: it is not a superseded record. The Donkey Sanctuary is 1207593, Registered since 2024-03-25, income GBP 59,557,831, company 15150580, which Companies House names THE DONKEY SANCTUARY. The charity's own website answers HTTP 403 to us, so it was not read; that is a check not made, not a check that failed.

The charity was removed from the register on 2023-09-15 and its company, 03049322, was dissolved on 2023-12-19 (Companies House). No registered charity of this name exists; the successor at the same address, BIG ISSUE CHANGING LIVES C.I.C. (14786850), is a community interest company and not a charity. The number stays on the row because it is the correct number for the charity that existed.

1058460 is EURO CHARITY TRUST, a different organisation. Maggie's is a Scottish charity: maggies.org states 'Registered Charity Number: SC024414' and company SC162451, and OSCR returns SC024414 as Maggie Keswick Jencks Cancer Caring Centres Trust, known as Maggie's, status Active.
